headline: **MLB Daily Recap: August 15, 2026**
article:
The St. Louis Cardinals suffered a 3-0 shutout loss to the Chicago Cubs, while the Cincinnati Reds edged out the Miami Marlins 1-0 in a thrilling victory. The Pittsburgh Pirates secured a 4-8 win over the Boston Red Sox, and the Chicago White Sox took down the Detroit Tigers in a pair of games, winning 9-5 and 4-3.

Injuries continue to plague several teams, with Sebastián Rivero (Los Angeles Angels) and Vladimir Guerrero Jr. (Toronto Blue Jays) being placed on the 60-day and 7-day injured lists, respectively. Abner Uribe (Milwaukee Brewers) was placed on the 15-day injured list retroactive to August 11, 2026, while Colt Emerson (Seattle Mariners) was placed on the 10-day injured list. Davis Martin (Chicago White Sox) was also placed on the 15-day injured list, and Matt Chapman (San Francisco Giants) was transferred to the 60-day injured list.

Several trades and roster moves have taken place, including the Milwaukee Brewers acquiring Jonathan Ornelas from the Athletics for cash, and the Baltimore Orioles receiving Harold Rivas from the Boston Red Sox as part of a player-to-be-named-later deal. The Kansas City Royals acquired Jacob Berry from the Miami Marlins.

top_news.title: **Cardinals Fall to Cubs in 3-0 Shutout**
top_news.summary: The St. Louis Cardinals suffered a 3-0 loss to the Chicago Cubs, with the Cubs' pitching staff shutting out the Cardinals.

top_news.title: **Reds Take Down Marlins in Thrilling 1-0 Victory**
top_news.summary: The Cincinnati Reds edged out the Miami Marlins 1-0, with Chase Burns pitching a stellar 7.0 innings, striking out 8 and allowing 0 earned runs. Eugenio Suárez led the Reds' offense with a crucial double that scored the game's only run.

top_news.title: **Pirates Take Down Red Sox 8-4**
top_news.summary: The Pittsburgh Pirates secured a 4-8 victory over the Boston Red Sox, with Bubba Chandler earning the win after 5.0 innings of work. Rafael Flores Jr. led the Red Sox offense with 3 hits, including a home run, and 2 RBIs.

top_news.title: **White Sox Take Down Tigers 9-5**
top_news.summary: The Chicago White Sox secured a 9-5 victory over the Detroit Tigers, with a strong performance from their offense. Miguel Vargas led the charge, hitting 4 home runs and driving in 3 runs in the game.

top_news.title: **White Sox Edge Tigers in Thrilling 4-3 Victory**
top_news.summary: The Chicago White Sox secured a narrow win over the Detroit Tigers, with a final score of 4-3. Randal Grichuk, Andrew Benintendi, Tristan Peters, and Eduardo Valencia all made significant contributions to the White Sox's victory.

top_news.title: **Cardinals Take Down Cubs 8-4**
top_news.summary: The St. Louis Cardinals secured an 8-4 victory over the Chicago Cubs, with multiple players contributing to the win. Alec Burleson, Joshua Báez, Blaze Jordan, Pedro Ramírez, and Michael Conforto were among the impact hitters, while Michael McGreevy stood out on the mound.

top_news.title: **Angels' Sebastián Rivero Lands on 60-Day Injured List**
top_news.summary: Los Angeles Angels catcher Sebastián Rivero has been placed on the 60-day injured list due to a left hamate fracture. The injury will keep him sidelined for an extended period.

top_news.title: **Brewers Bolster Infield with Ornelas Acquisition**
top_news.summary: The Milwaukee Brewers have added shortstop Jonathan Ornelas to their roster, acquired in a trade with the Athletics for cash.
